g_roast: Family, I've looked in a lot of mouths, and this group has the coordination of a patient trying to talk with the drill in.
Aman, look at us. If I lined you all up in my chair, every single one would need a root canal and a lecture about flossing.
g_fire_back: Ha, very good, very good! My brothers said worse before breakfast, and they had their mouths full.
Says the one who flinched when I just looked at their arm. I didn't even touch it, canim, I looked!
g_pile_on: Oh, it's worse, it's so much worse. I watched that one try to eat soup with a fork, very determined, very slowly.
Yes, yes, and I have it written in my notebook, page forty, under people who should never hold a knife.
lines.g_peacemake: Hey, hey, enough, both of you! Open wide, take a breath, and spit it out properly, then we all have tea.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one. I like you both, and you know I like everybody, but here you're wrong.
lines.g_left_out: You two have your own whole conversation, eh? It's fine, it's fine, I'll go introduce myself to that tree over there.
lines.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a place! In my family, nobody eats standing at the edge of the room.
lines.g_bad_plan: Okay, listen, I have a plan. I go first and tell them a joke so terrible they stop fighting out of pity, and then you hit them.
lines.g_plan_yes: Yes, I love it, I'm in! I'll stay right behind you with my bag open.
lines.g_plan_no: No, no, no, canim, I'm the one stitching you up afterwards, and I'm telling you that plan ends in my chair.
lines.g_hype: Come on, family, let's go! Big smiles, clean work, and nobody comes out missing any teeth!
lines.g_toast: A toast, a toast, everybody stand up! To the best patients I've ever had, who still sit with me after I've hurt them.
lines.g_cheers: Serefe, family, and somebody pour for the quiet one, they're too polite to ask.
g_quiet_line: Mashallah, nobody died today. My grandmother would light a candle for that.
Somebody here needs a filling, by the way. I can hear it when they chew.
lines.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, everybody's breathing, I checked. Now sit, open your hands, show me where it hurts, and nobody's allowed to be brave about it.
lines.g_crew: My grandmother had one test for family, did you eat at my table and argue with me after. Every one of you passes, so that's it, you're family.
lines.g_exasperated: Aman Allahim, family, I spend all day keeping you in one piece and you run at things like it's a party!
lines.g_love_sharp: You say the true thing straight away, no anaesthetic. Most people make me guess, and you just tell me where it hurts.
lines.g_love_kind: You looked after the healer, canim. Nobody looks after the healer, and you did it without me asking once.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and that's my whole job, you're stealing my whole job! I love it, keep stealing it.
lines.g_love_brave: You walk in first and you don't even blink. I've watched grown men faint at a needle, and you walk into fire.
lines.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake. In my surgery that was the most important thing, and you've got the steadiest hands here.
lines.g_love_clever: You see how the tiny parts fit together. It's like watching someone who really knows teeth, and I love it.
lines.g_love_honest: You've never lied to me, not even the little lies people tell their dentist. In my job, that's like finding gold in a molar.
lines.g_love_quiet: You don't talk much, so when you do, I put my notebook down. That's a compliment, I never put my notebook down.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never quit, never! It's like my grandmother arguing with the butcher, you just keep going until you win.
lines.g_love_warm: Being around you sounds like dinner at home, everybody loud, everybody happy. I've been missing that sound so much.
g_loved: Ah, stop it, stop it, I'll start crying, and then I can't see to do the stitches.
Me, really, you mean that? Mashallah, that's going in the notebook, the good page, the one I don't show anybody.
lines.g_hate_sharp: Every time somebody's happy you have to bite. It's like a bad tooth, canim, it hurts everybody near it.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to look after me, and I'm the one who looks after people! Let me do my job, please.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, and I'm the joker, so you know it's bad if I'm saying it.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run in without looking, every time, and then I'm the one picking splinters out of you at midnight.
lines.g_hate_steady: You think and think and think, and the patient is still sitting in the chair waiting. Sometimes you just pull the tooth.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I didn't do five years of study. I did, canim, and my grandmother told the whole street.
lines.g_hate_honest: You say everything true, even when somebody's scared. With a scared patient, first you make them laugh, then the truth.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You won't tell anybody where it hurts. How can I fix it if you keep your mouth shut? That's literally my job.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you. It's not a competition, it's a team, like a surgery, everybody has a job.
lines.g_hate_warm: The talking never ends with you, and I'm saying that, me, the loudest man in Izmir. Think how bad that is.
lines.g_respect: I don't like you, and I like everybody, so that's saying something. But that was clean work back there, I'll admit it.
lines.g_call_out: That one was on you, canim. You ran in before I was ready, and now I'm stitching your arm instead of eating my dinner.
lines.g_stung: Okay, okay, I heard you, thank you very much. I'm going to go organise my bag very loudly.
lines.g_concede: So, you were right, and I've been sulking, and I hate sulking, it's so quiet. You were right, there, I said it.
lines.g_nod: Ha, okay, you too, you too. Now don't tell anybody, I have a reputation for liking people.
lines.g_callback_save: Remember when you dragged me out of that mess? I still owe you, and I don't like owing people, it's very un-Turkish.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two up, both of us laughing like idiots! I tell everybody that story, I've added a dragon to it.
lines.g_callback_callout: That time you shouted at me, I sulked for a whole day, a whole day, me! My mother would never believe it.
lines.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to put you in my chair and forget the anaesthetic. Look at us today, eh? Life is a very strange patient.
lines.g_changed: I used to talk so nobody could hear how scared I was. Now I talk because I like you. It's different, I can feel it.
g_unguarded: Okay, secret, just for you. I've used this mirror twice for teeth and about forty times to see round corners. I'm a terrible dentist now.
My grandmother told the whole street I was a doctor, not a dentist. I never corrected her, not once, and I'm not sorry.
lines.g_clipped: Sure, okay, fine. I'll just check the bags, quietly, for once.
lines.g_noticed_open: Listen to this one, talking! I knew it, I knew you had a big voice in there somewhere, keep going!
arg_ask: {player}, you decide! You're the sensible one here, and this one won't listen to a dentist.
Okay, okay, {player}, settle it, please, before I start telling everybody my opinion very loudly.
lines.arg_backed_me: Ha, you see? The boss agrees with me! I'm writing that in the notebook.
lines.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, you two can be right together. I'll sit in the corner being right on my own.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it? Smart, very smart, my father did the same at every family dinner.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Them, again, always them, {player}! I'm beginning to wonder if I'm the problem, and I'm never the problem.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to decide, so I'm deciding. I win, everybody have tea, it's settled.
lines.arg_reject: Sorry, canim, {player}, I love you, but the answer is no. I've looked inside this one and you haven't.
lines.arg_grumble: Still think I was right about that one, by the way. I'm not angry, I'm just mentioning it, often.
lines.arg_settled: Okay, call it a draw, like two good molars side by side. Shake my hand, and then we eat.
lines.seen_listens: You let me finish my stories, {player}, even the long ones. Nobody lets me finish, not even my own grandmother.
lines.seen_truth: You tell people the real thing, {player}, even when it hurts. Good dentists do that, after the joke.
lines.seen_jokes: The worse it gets, the funnier you get, {player}. That's my trick! I'm so proud, and a little jealous.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep your nose out of everybody's fights, {player}. My father did that for forty years, and he had a very peaceful life.
lines.seen_biased: The whole table knows who your favourite is, {player}. It's okay, I just wish it was me.
lines.seen_harsh: Some days you come down hard on folks, {player}. Some of them are tough, but some are scared, and scared needs gentle.
lines.seed_right: What you told me after that disaster, {player}? I hated it. Today I listened, and nobody ended up in my chair.
lines.seed_remember: Your words after that one went bad are still rattling round in my head like a loose filling. I haven't decided yet.
lines.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse, sorry. Just so you know, I'm not angry, I'm reporting.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: {player}, canim, sit with me a minute? My hands are shaking, and my hands are never allowed to shake.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all fell over back there, eh? Everybody's patched up, but I want to talk about it before I make a joke instead.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was right there with my bag when {name} went down, right there, and I was too slow. I keep seeing it, over and over.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, the whole thing, start to end, everybody walking! Come here, I have to hug somebody or I'll explode.
lines.talk_development: Can I tell you something strange, {player}? I think I'm changing, and I can't tell if it's the good kind or the bad kind.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I was too sharp with {name}, I think. I joke when I'm scared, and maybe it landed wrong.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me the truth, {player}, the dentist truth. Does {name} like me, or am I too loud for them?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me crazy, {player}, really crazy. But if I'm hurt, I'd want those steady hands on me, and that's annoying.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't eating properly, {player}, I've been watching. People stop eating when something's wrong inside.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Can we talk, {player}? All the shiny gear goes to {name}, all of it. I counted, the way I count teeth.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I like everybody, you know that. But not {name}, and I'm tired of smiling about it.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places that put people in my chair, {player}. I'm a good healer, but I'm not that good.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: This is about {name}. Their call was the right one, mine was the wrong one, and I have to say it before I chicken out.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you think I'm only good for patching people up, {player}? When it gets serious, I'm always the one left at the inn.
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went to {name} and nobody asked the dentist. I'd have handed it over with a smile! Just ask, canim, please.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, okay, thank you, that helps. Now let me check your hands, it's my turn.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, I'll be okay. I always heal, eventually.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: Oh, aman, that's not the medicine I wanted, but okay. I'll go sort my bandages.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you see it as well! Good, good, now I'm less scared of it.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Yavas yavas, we'll see.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, canim. You're looking at the wrong tooth.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Yes, you're right. I'll find {name} now and sort it, before I talk myself out of it.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe so, we'll see. People are tougher work than teeth, and teeth are tough.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Pretend I said nothing, please? And not a word to {name}, okay?
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, fair, fair. I'm still a little bruised, but it heals.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. It goes in the bag with the needles, and I'll look at it later.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Oh, so that's how it is. Okay, now I know, {player}.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, we're finished with this, sorry. I'll be with the bandages if you need me.
lines.arc_cracks: I told a joke to a patient today and forgot the end of it. I've never forgotten the end of a joke, family, never.
lines.arc_turn: I make everybody laugh so they won't be scared. Today I realised I've been doing it to myself for three years, and it stopped working.
lines.arc_become: I still tell the jokes, family. They're just quieter now, and some of them are sad, and that's okay.
lines.arc_failed: Ha, look at me, worrying about nothing! It's all good, all good, everybody have tea, nothing to see here.
lines.alt_turn: I carry everybody's fear for them, I take it out like a bad tooth. Nobody ever takes mine, and I've stopped asking.
lines.alt_become: Somebody else held my hand today while I shook, and I let them. First time in three years, I think.
g_roast_after: Look at us, family, broken, patched, glued, and I wouldn't trade a single one of you for a new surgery.
Worst patients in the world, all of you, and the only ones I'd stitch up for free.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we fell over, and it hurt, and I'm not going to joke about it this time. Come here, sit, we fix it together.
lines.g_toast_after: To the people who make me laugh when I'm the one who's scared. I didn't know I needed that, family.
lines.g_crew_after: With you lot I don't have to perform, not one joke. That's what home felt like, and you're it now.
g_quiet_line_after: Quiet tonight, eh? I don't even mind it, which is very strange for me.
Nobody needed stitches today, and I didn't tell a single joke. Both are miracles.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, I'm just going to sit with that one, no joke.
Ah, that's kind of you. I'm keeping it, and for once there's no joke attached.

history.open: Did you know I keep a list of every transplant who was a medic on Earth, {player}? Four hundred and twelve names, and I've met most of them.

options.text: Why keep a list like that?
options.reply: Because nobody else was! Somebody gets hurt in a town with no healer, and on page sixty there's a nurse two valleys over. That's the whole idea.
Ha, not unless you were a vet or a nurse. But you're on the other list, people I like, and that one's much shorter.

options.text: Four hundred and twelve? That's incredible, Berat.
options.reply: It is, eh? My grandmother would tell the whole street. Okay, I'm telling the whole street for her.

history.open: This mirror behind my ear, {player}? It was there when I landed. A patient in my chair, the drill going, and then trees.

options.reply: I don't know, and I think about it more than you'd guess. I hope he got a good dentist. I hope he didn't keep the bad tooth out of spite.

options.text: Do you still use it for teeth?
options.reply: Twice, in three whole years, I swear. Mostly I use it to see round corners now. My professors would cry.

history.open: My family lived on four floors of one building in Izmir, {player}. Three generations, three brothers, more cousins than I can count, all shouting at once.

options.reply: Every day, every single day. It's too quiet everywhere here. That's why I talk so much, I think, I'm making the noise for them.

options.text: You'll find them. I know it.
options.reply: I say that too, every morning, like a prayer. It helps when somebody else says it, so thank you, canim.

friend.open: Okay, a secret, {player}. There was a girl, Elif. My mother had very firm plans for us, and I was getting used to the idea. She laughed at all my jokes, even the bad ones, which was all of them.

options.text: Do you think about her a lot?
options.reply: Some nights, yes. Not like a love song, more like a door I never got to open. I hope she found someone with better jokes.

options.text: Thank you for telling me, Berat.
options.reply: I've never told anybody here, not one person. You're on the short list now, canim, the very short one.

sworn.open: My grandmother used to say you only know who your family is when you're the one who's sick, {player}. I've been sick, a bit, inside, and you stayed with me.

options.reply: Of course, he says, like it's nothing! It's everything, {player}. You're family now, the real kind, no notebook needed.
She'd love you, she'd feed you until you couldn't walk, and then she'd tell the whole street you're a doctor.

reconciled.open: Me and {name} sat down and talked it through, properly, no jokes. We're good again, and I wanted you to hear it first.

options.reply: It is, eh? I hate being on bad terms with anybody, it gives me a toothache in my soul.
Okay, maybe one, at the very end, a small one. But it landed, so it counts as healing.
